ops.entry: WHEN a signoff or plan characterizes a behaviour delta DO hand that characterization to a panel reader as a falsifiable claim to probe base-vs-pin on data-carrying instances — criteria witness only enumerated examples, so a false characterization surfaces only if someone runs that probe.
ops.why: A signoff's 'bytes identical' account, generalized from a rowless example, was falsified only because readers spontaneously probed base vs pin with row-carrying shapes; no SC witnessed it and the c0 ruling's Gap names the missing witness. Displaces P-07, which the code-reviewer's own selection-rule gotcha already holds at reader level.

ops.entry: WHEN ruling a must-fix against a defect class DO hand down every state the decision consumes and the representation the clause names, requiring a discriminating mutant per state and per representation (a newline-normalizing writer for bytes) — instance-scoped or normalized remedies close one member per round, and rounds are budgeted.
ops.why: My must_fix said 'assert exact file bytes' without naming the mutant; the fix delivered a text-mode read a CRLF writer passed, and the c1 ruling had to grant a completion round. Sharpens P-12 to cover the representation axis; same length.

ops.entry: WHEN a member reports a signed criterion met under a narrowed reading DO record literal status and reading as two findings, route the reading up, and recommend the letter fix when cheap and inside a task's files — a ruler can prefer a small fix to a permanently contested criterion.
ops.why: I recommended accepting an intent-met reading of a bytes clause; the c1 ruling chose the ~10-line fix instead, reasoning an interpretive override leaves a contested record auditors read literally. Sharpens G-10 with which option to recommend.

originals.original: WHEN two readings of a gate's output disagree about what it reports DO read the gate's own selection rule before adjudicating — the rule decides which result shapes are representable at all, and it can retire a reported partition at a fraction of the cost of arguing the readings.

WHEN ruling a must-fix against a defect class DO hand down the class's full state matrix — every axis the decision consumes, each state a caller can produce — and require a discriminating mutant per cell; an instance-scoped remedy closes one member per round, and rounds are budgeted.

WHEN a member reports a signed criterion met under a narrowed reading DO record the literal status and the reading as two findings and route the reading up — endorsing it adopts an approval-gated decision, and the tier owning the goal can reject the reading outright.
